Gemini Image Prompt — Beat 7

Generate exactly one 9:16 image: a small Dumbo octopus viewed from a distant high three-quarter angle, gliding gently through a vast open deep-ocean water column, full body visible low-center with generous surrounding negative space; its paired ear-like fins are caught at opposite phases of a soft flap, clarified by a few restrained curved motion marks. Render as monochrome educational line-art on smooth matte off-white paper with extremely light natural tooth: clean confident rounded carbon-black monoline contours, simplified biologically recognizable anatomy, minimal interior detail, sparse graphite-gray micro-accents, no heavy shadows, flat diffuse illustrative lighting, depth shown through scale, overlap, contour density, tiny drifting particulate, bubbles and current marks; optionally use one extremely sparse abyssal-cyan accent only if it supports a key anatomical feature. Maintain the recurring thin hand-drawn outer contour and organically interlocking illustration-window language while using the full image height naturally, with no caption reserve or low-detail bottom strip. Reference roles: style_reference guides the general visual treatment only; world_keyframe establishes this ocean world's canonical medium, palette, texture, lighting and frame language; operator_style_reference informs crisp contour rhythm and editorial educational clarity without copying its people, objects, text or composition; previous_beat is binding only for recurring frame material, edge treatment, inner-window language, texture, palette and lighting, never its crop, camera angle, pose, subject placement or focal object. No photorealism, 3D CGI, anime, painterly effects, watercolor, collage, halftones, dense engraving, neon palette, gradients, horror styling, decorative typography, labels, UI, readable text, storyboard, grid, collage or panels. NON-NEGOTIABLE EPISODE FRAME CONTRACT: Preserve this recurring frame language in this image: a consistent clean off-white matte field bounded by a thin hand-drawn black contour near the outer edge, occasionally interrupted by tiny bubble, current, or plankton marks; each scene sits inside an organically interlocking line-art illustration window rather than a rigid panel, with generous white breathing channels separating creature silhouettes. The same thin contour weight, rounded corners, scattered miniature ocean marks, and open negative-space rhythm repeat across every body image. The lower edge transitions naturally into a quieter low-detail field rather than a hard caption box.. Preserve its material/edge grammar, texture, palette and inner illustration window while changing only the scene inside it. Do not reserve a lower caption field, blank strip, empty panel or low-detail band. Continue the scene and its natural texture through the full usable height, guided by the previous accepted image, without adding text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, words or UI.
